name: London School of Economics and Political Science
description: The London School of Economics and Political Science is a public research university in London founded in 1895 and specialising in the social sciences, including economics, politics, law, sociology and management.
whyIncluded: LSE reports 308 undergraduate and 105 graduate students from Singapore (2025), and its LLB is on SILE's list of scheduled universities for admission to the Singapore Bar.

livingCosts.notes: LSE publishes a single all-in estimate: 'students should allow £1,550 per month for all living expenses, including accommodation, travel, food, laundry, study costs, and other personal expenses'. It is not itemised, so the whole amount is recorded under housing (food, transport and personal are included in it, not additional). The same page indicates food alone at £150-£300 a month and private housing from about £650 a month. 9 months = the undergraduate academic year (October-June); the visa maintenance requirement also counts 9 months.

programmes.name: BSc Data Science
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2026/27 new entrants from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27. LSE fixes overseas undergraduate fees at the year-of-entry level for the whole programme. The tuition fee covers registration, examination and Students' Union membership; no separate compulsory fees. LSE has no computer science degree; Data Science is the closest programme. History: 2025/26 Table of Fees (£29,200) and 2024/25 Table of Fees (£27,192).

programmes.name: BSc Management
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2026/27 new entrants from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27; fixed at the year-of-entry level for the whole programme. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 Table of Fees (£34,000) and 2024/25 Table of Fees (£27,192).

programmes.name: BSc Mathematics and Economics
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2026/27 new entrants from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27; fixed at the year-of-entry level for the whole programme. No separate compulsory fees. LSE offers no physics or biology; mathematics is its science programme. History: 2025/26 Table of Fees (£34,000) and 2024/25 Table of Fees (£27,192).

programmes.name: BSc Economics
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2026/27 new entrants from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27; fixed at the year-of-entry level for the whole programme. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 Table of Fees (£34,000) and 2024/25 Table of Fees (£28,176).

programmes.name: MSc Data Science
programmes.notes: Full-time overseas fee for 2026/27 from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27 (same as the Home fee). One-year programme; LSE says fees normally rise each year. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 (£38,000) and 2024/25 (£36,168) Tables of Fees.

programmes.name: MSc Management (12-Month Programme)
programmes.notes: Full-time overseas fee for 2026/27 from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27 (same as the Home fee); includes the compulsory international study trip. One-year programme; LSE says fees normally rise each year. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 (£41,000) and 2024/25 (£38,472) Tables of Fees.

programmes.name: MSc Statistics
programmes.notes: Full-time overseas fee for 2026/27 from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27 (Home fee £18,300). Financial Statistics streams cost more (£39,900). One-year programme; LSE says fees normally rise each year. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 (£28,900, 'all streams except Financial Statistics') and 2024/25 (£27,480) Tables of Fees.

programmes.name: MSc Economics
programmes.notes: Full-time overseas fee for the one-year MSc Economics for 2026/27 from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27 (same as the Home fee; the two-year MSc Economics is listed separately at £39,900 + £43,100). LSE says fees normally rise each year. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 (£39,000) and 2024/25 (£36,480) Tables of Fees.

programmes.name: LLB Bachelor of Laws
programmes.notes: Overseas fee for 2026/27 new entrants from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27 ('LLB in Laws' row; Home £9,790); fixed at the year-of-entry level for the whole programme. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 Table of Fees (£34,000) and 2024/25 Table of Fees (£28,176).

programmes.name: LLM Master of Laws
programmes.notes: Full-time overseas fee for 2026/27 from LSE's Table of Fees 2026/27 ('Master of Laws' row; Home £24,500; part-time £19,950 a year). One-year programme; LSE says fees normally rise each year. No separate compulsory fees. History: 2025/26 (£38,000) and 2024/25 (£36,168) Tables of Fees, where the row is labelled 'LLM'.
